_doctrine: Babel-Cascade P-Matrix — per Gemini-blueprint (2026-05-20) + doctrine-class refinement. Mothertongue=P1, max-linguistic-inverse=P2, relatives=P3, lesser-inverse=P4, periphery=P5-P7. Per [[baal_whipper_doctrine]] each labrador uses INDEPENDENT search-path in its own language-space — no shared pre-search-context across labradors.
_authority_split: Each labrador fetches own context via own per-lang Hebel-B. Voting on text-claims, not on shared embeddings.

_early_stop.phase_1_agree: If P1+P2 converge 2/2 → fire P3 for confirmation → if 3/3 EARLY STOP
_early_stop.phase_1_disagree: If P1+P2 split 1/2 → fire full cascade until 4/7 majority
_early_stop.morpheme_check: Before voting, normalize morpheme variants (ECHELON/Echelon/Échelon = same). Outliers (Echeline) → [[ai_chain_morpheme_genesis]] triage, NOT majority-mitteln.

labrador_assignments._note: Phase α: only P1+P2 wired with existing infra. Phase β-γ: full stack.
